career_ladder.note: Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) is India's premier export finance institution, established by an Act of Parliament (The Export-Import Bank of India Act, 1981). Management Trainees (MTs) undergo 1 year of intensive training, after which they are absorbed as Deputy Managers in Junior Management Grade (JM-I). Progression follows statutory financial institution scales through Middle Management, Senior Management, and Executive Cadres.

steps.source_label: Exim Bank — Recruitment of Management Trainees Advt. No. HRM/MT/2024-25/01
Exim Bank Officer Service Regulations — Scale I absorption framework

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted through a two-stage process: an Online Examination (comprising both Objective and Descriptive tests in a single sitting) followed by a Personal Interview for shortlisted candidates. Objective test carries a negative marking penalty of 1/4th (0.25) mark per wrong answer.

Descriptive Test: English Essay & Letter Writing
Descriptive Test: Professional Knowledge in Banking & Trade Finance

financial_package.note: During the 1-year training period, Management Trainees are paid a consolidated monthly stipend of ₹65,000. On successful completion of training and absorption as Deputy Manager (JM-I), officers are placed in the Grade JM-I scale (₹48,480 - 2,000/7 - 62,480 - 2,340/2 - 67,160 - 2,680/7 - 85,920) with standard banking/financial institution DA and allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Exim Bank — Advt. No. HRM/MT/2024-25/01 (Emoluments & Service Conditions)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on post-absorption entry basic pay of ₹48,480 plus applicable Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (or leased accommodation up to institutional limits), Special Allowance, and City Compensatory Allowance; net salary accounts for standard pension/PF deduction.
official_perks: Fixed stipend of ₹65,000/month during 1-year Management Trainee period
Bank leased residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance upon absorption
Comprehensive medical facility / reimbursement for self and dependent family
Defined contribution pension and provident fund benefits
Concessional loan facilities, briefcase allowance, and book grant provisions

competition_benchmarks.note: Recruitment of Management Trainees in Exim Bank is conducted annually based on institutional requirements. In the 2024-25 cycle (Advt. No. HRM/MT/2024-25/01), 50 vacancies were notified for Management Trainees (Banking Operations).
